project_type: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite SPA with Zustand state management
build_system: Vite 6 with npm scripts; no build quirks
verification_instructions: 1. Run vitest to confirm all unit tests pass. 2. Run npm run build to confirm no TypeScript/build errors. 3. Existing tests may need updates if data-testid attributes or component structure changes.
environment_constraints: No Supabase instance available, tests mock @/lib/supabase. E2E tests require env vars that are absent. Only unit tests and build can be verified.
contribution_requirements: UI-only changes. Do NOT modify backend security, RLS, RPCs, or database schema. Do NOT change the designLibraryStore's fetch/filter logic.
key_patterns: Inline styles using CSS custom properties from design-system.css. Zustand stores with selector pattern. data-testid attributes on key elements. Components export from index.ts barrel. Existing CSS utility classes in components.css (btn-primary, btn-secondary, status-chip, etc). Animations in animations.css (panel-slide-in, card hover, chip-appear).
directory_structure: frontend/src/components/ProjectCreation/ - main Design Library UI components. frontend/src/stores/ - Zustand stores. frontend/src/styles/ - CSS design system. frontend/src/types/ - TypeScript interfaces.
